title: Surpanakha sees Rama
topic: Aranya Kanda — Surpanakha desires Rama at Panchavati
disclaimer: Dramatized from the public Ramayana Aranya Kanda tradition. Adult-stark test episode for ComicEngine 2A. Desire is explicit; not exploitation. Not bedtime.
story_goal: Panchavati; she is struck by Rama; proposes; he refuses and points her to Lakshmana.
framework_goal: Desire + two-person blocking + forest light lock. Cast: Rama, Surpanakha, Sita glimpsed.
gate: Bible looks hold; shot cards make her approach readable without restaging.
narrative_summary: Surpanakha finds the ashram. She wants Rama. He refuses without cruelty and names Lakshmana. She turns.

fact_checks.claim: Surpanakha desires Rama in exile and is refused.

panels.scene_description: Wide: Panchavati ashram in late light. Rama strings nothing; he sits with the bow across his knees. Sita at the hut mouth, water pot.
panels.caption: Panchavati. Exile has a kitchen and a weapon.

shot_card.camera: wide, slightly high, hut left, river suggestion right
shot_card.lighting: warm west key, long tree shadows
shot_card.blocking: Rama downstage center; Sita in doorway; Lakshmana off
shot_card.dramatic_purpose: Lock ashram and forest light for later callbacks.

panels.scene_description: Surpanakha in the trees, whole-form, watching. Desire on her face before she steps into the clearing.
panels.caption: She has hunted worse than princes.

shot_card.camera: medium, foliage frame, her eyes sharp
shot_card.lighting: same west key, cooler in the understory
shot_card.blocking: she occupies the right third, ashram tiny behind leaves

panels.scene_description: She walks into the clearing. Rama does not stand yet. Two-person blocking: she closes distance; he holds the bow like a boundary.
panels.dialogue: SURPANAKHA: I have looked at many men. You are not many men.

shot_card.camera: over Rama's shoulder, her full approach
shot_card.lighting: her face in warm light; his back half-shadow
shot_card.blocking: she center walking; he seated, bow horizontal
shot_card.dramatic_purpose: Desire as blocking, not as a joke.

panels.scene_description: Closer. She is beautiful-form and frank. Rama's face is calm, not disgusted, not flattered.
panels.dialogue:
RAMA: I am married. That is the whole of it.
SURPANAKHA: Wives are a custom. I am not.

shot_card.camera: two-shot, eye level, no dutch-angle drama
shot_card.lighting: split: gold on her mouth, cooler on his
shot_card.blocking: equal height if she leans in; he does not retreat

panels.scene_description: Sita in the doorway, watching. Not a decorative insert — she hears this.
panels.caption: Sita does not pretend not to hear.

shot_card.camera: medium doorway, hut interior dark behind
shot_card.lighting: rim from the west; her face readable
shot_card.dramatic_purpose: Sita is present. Glimpsed, not erased.

panels.scene_description: Rama turns his head toward the trees where Lakshmana appears with firewood. He names the brother.
panels.dialogue:
RAMA: My brother is there. He is not bound as I am.
LAKSHMANA: I heard my name used as a gift.

shot_card.camera: three-point: Rama seated, Surpanakha standing, Lakshmana entering left
shot_card.lighting: same key; Lakshmana steps into light
shot_card.dramatic_purpose: Redirect is plot, not a sitcom beat.

panels.scene_description: She looks Lakshmana over. Appetite does not vanish; it recalculates. His face is already less kind than Rama's.
panels.dialogue:
SURPANAKHA: Then I will not waste a married mouth.
LAKSHMANA: You will not use me as a spare.

shot_card.camera: medium two-shot, slightly low on him
shot_card.lighting: harder shadow on his scarf/arm-wrap (identity lock)
shot_card.blocking: she turns fully away from Rama
shot_card.dramatic_purpose: Set ep 2. Distinguish Lakshmana by wrap, not by a different art style.

panels.scene_description: She leaves the clearing, not yet wounded, already insulted by the math. Forest swallows her. Ashram stays warm in the background — the light lock must match panel 1.
panels.caption: She will not ask a third time.

shot_card.camera: wide, her back, ashram small and still golden
shot_card.lighting: west key dying; her silhouette cooler
shot_card.blocking: exit right; hut left as in p01
shot_card.dramatic_purpose: Close on continuity: same place, storm coming.
